text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One weekend, I'm out and about when I
spot Nakayama heading
down an alley. In
spite of myself, I can't help but remember
the
rumors from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what they put on the table, but
they're lookin' for her like
their life
depends on it. Yeesh. Who knows what'll
happen if they find
her?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's just you. I'm not up to much,
just a bit of this and that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If anything were to happen to my trainee,
it's my job as a trainer to
step in and
protect her. As she looks me over, I open
my mouth to try
and explain more, when
she speaks up herself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You've got weird taste too, huh? Suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Owner of Tiny Restaurant
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Nakayama. Offal stew, hot
outta the pot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, "weird taste" meant a
hole-in-the-wall joint hidden down
an
unassuming alley. There's a good number
of chairs and tables set
out, so the place
must be doing fairly well for itself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now this is the good stuff. Man...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks great as always!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Perfect... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that hit the spot. Nothing fills an
empty belly like offal. Oh,
also... could I
get the beef and tofu dish and some pork
stomach?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We eat our fill and head out, but just as
we leave the alley, we're
suddenly called
over by... a policeman?!

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I was right, it was you after all. I've been
looking for you. And... this is
your
guardian, I presume?

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I know this is sudden, but if possible,
could I ask you to come down to
the
station with me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. Just get it over with.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Puppy
text_block_list.text: Arf arf! Arf!

text_block_list.name: Puppy's Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, aw, Mugi. You remember her? She
saved you!

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
She found a "stray" puppy, and was caring
for her by the riverbank.
Meanwhile, I was
trying to get the lost pup back to her
owner, and
went to take her.

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I caused a bit of a misunderstanding, so
Nakayama Festa and I got off
on the
wrong foot, but I'm glad I could let you
know how everything
worked out in the
end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You didn't have to keep me posted. And I didn't need to come all the way here to see the pup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...So I was right after all. The bad rumors
about Nakayama were just

misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It falls dark, and we're starting to cut it
close with Nakayama's curfew.
I'm just
about to suggest heading back to Tracen,
when...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! It's Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A group of rough-looking high schoolers
swarm us and walk us down
to the
riverbank, out of sight from the street.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
I've been lookin' for you, Nakayama. I hear
you cheated my boys in
poker, and acted
like you beat them all legit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I did beat 'em legit. They just lost on their
own. I didn't use anything
but my head, so
shut up and accept that you got
outplayed.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen A
text_block_list.text:
You shut up! Like hell you were playin'
fair! No one'd ever go all in
with a hand
that bad, not without knowing what cards
we had!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Now quit playin' dumb, or we'll
make sure you can never run
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes a second to realize that the retort
had just come out of my
own mouth.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, you stay outta this. This one's
between them and me.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
That badge... So you're this cheat's trainer,
huh? If you don't mind
your own business,
you're goin' down first.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? You're actin' awful confident.
You wanna spend the rest of
your life
phonin' in training plans from the hospital?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The one who seems to be in charge of the group cracks his knuckles menacingly. I size him up, and ooooh, I do not fancy my chances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But win or lose, I'm not standing down. I'm
a trainer! I won't let them
lay a hand on
Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stepping in front of Nakayama, I put my
arms up and walk over to the
guy,
stopping right in front of him.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hang on. You're joking, right?

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
Tch... The hell is with you two?! This ain't
worth it. C'mon guys, we're
outta here!
Who knows what these cheats are up to...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, ahahaha! You didn't bat an eyelash
challenging a whole gang,
and now you're
shaking like a baby. Hahahah... so much
for your big
bluff.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you ever run into guys like that, just
brush 'em off and ig...nore...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. Well, well. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. See? Take a look at yourself. At
what you really are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still shaking, it takes a second to follow
her gaze to a shop window,
where I see my
own reflection.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken aback by the... the look on my
face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now... workin' with you just got real interesting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm locked in a daze the whole walk home.
When I finally cross the
door, it's like my
body runs cold. I'm hit with a wave of
exhaustion,
and I flop down on my bed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring my hands up to my face, and just
watch as they shake. The
image of myself
in that window is burned into my mind,
Nakayama's
words echoing in my ears.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. See? Take a look at yourself. At
what you really are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something about her laughter, the
knowing look in her eyes... the
look I saw
in my own eyes... It all whirls again and
again through my
mind.
